offers_products.reason: Designs and manufactures PX Pressure Exchanger devices and pumps for desalination and wastewater.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is mainly from device sales; technical support and aftermarket parts are incidental to the products.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells equipment to desalination plant builders, OEMs and operators, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are water-system OEMs, engineering firms, municipal and industrial desalination and wastewater plant operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue comes from project-based PX device orders for new plants; aftermarket and service revenue is smaller.

cyclical_demand.reason: Water infrastructure projects are driven by freshwater need and regulation, though project timing can slip.

big_ticket.reason: Capital equipment ordered per plant project, infrequent and large relative to component budgets.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for proprietary manufactured pressure exchanger devices, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are large desalination OEMs, EPC contractors, utilities and municipal or industrial water plant operators.

asset_heavy.reason: Manufactures ceramic-based devices in California facilities; light manufacturing, not plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Judgments on recurring revenue and customer mix come from general knowledge of the company, not the website text.
